purpose: Store student profiles and their relationships to parents, teachers, and sessions.

fields.parentIds: array of strings (Firebase UIDs), required, references users/{uid}
fields.sessionIds: array of strings, optional, references sessions/{sessionId}
fields.enrollmentIds: array of strings, optional, references enrollments/{enrollmentId}
fields.progressSummary: map, optional, stores aggregated progress data per course/topic
fields.updatedBy: string (UID), required, set on every write
fields.updatedAt: timestamp, required, server-set on every write

access_patterns.parent: read if parentId in parentIds, no write

validation_rules: parentIds array must not be empty
birthDate must be a valid ISO-8601 date
createdBy must equal auth.uid on create
teacherId must reference a valid user with role 'teacher'
performance_notes: Indexes on teacherId and parentIds are critical for efficient queries.
